scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/server
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names shared,server,client,worker "npm run dev --workspace=@gitfolio/shared" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/server && npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/shared && npm test --workspace=@gitfolio/server && npm test --workspace=@gitfolio/client
scripts.oauth:check: npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run oauth:check --workspace=@gitfolio/server
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace=@gitfolio/shared && npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed --workspace=@gitfolio/server
